title: Article 20 — Protection in respect of conviction for offences

content.overview: Article 20 has three protections: no ex post facto criminal law, no double jeopardy after prosecution and punishment for the same offence, and no compelled self-incrimination.
content.study: Person here is not limited to citizens. Compulsion is the key word in clause (3). Do not collapse Article 20 into Article 21 procedure.
